intro.text: A legendary queen of the Silver Kingdom of Natanatan, an architect of great towers, known from a Natan folk tale.

items.text: In the tale, the moon Mishim tried to tempt Queen Tsa into swapping places with her. Tsa refused until Mishim claimed one of her towers had a flaw visible only from the sky. Tsa promised to look only at her towers. Mishim spent the night partying, missed her return, and spent an anxious day on Roshar, then learned the other moons had welcomed Tsa with feasts.

Some months afterwards, Mishim saw Tsa holding a baby with faintly blue skin and realised she had been tricked: Tsa had wanted a night in the heavens to have a child by the moon Nomon. The tale says this is why the Natan have blue skin.

Sigzil once tried to tell Kaladin the story to explain why he felt responsible for the religious differences among his comrades, but muddled it. In Kholinar, Shallan heard Wit tell it in a market, shaping smoke into figures as he spoke.

personality.text: Pious and devoted to the moon Nomon, and clever enough to deceive Mishim.
